note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Layered autumn outfits keep dominating: oversized knit sweaters, suede and leather jackets, trench coats, wide-leg trousers, pleated skirts, loafers and ankle boots in browns, beige, navy and olive. Popular formats include 'the outfit vs the inspo' reels built around fall colors and multi-day outfit series like '20 Days of Autumn Outfits' and 'just add layers' lookbooks.
trends.title: Layered fall outfits, styled day after day

trends.details: White sectional sofas, chunky knit blankets, lit candles, chandeliers, wood ceilings and fireplaces set the cozy fall living room. With Halloween a day away, decorating reels surge: ceramic ghosts, pumpkin-shaped candles, dried botanicals, pinecones and faux spiders layered over the same warm autumn base.
trends.title: Cozy fall living rooms, now with Halloween touches

trends.details: Soft fall glam leads: breathable base, cream contour and blush blended for a soft-sculpted finish, soft brows, fluttery lashes and glossy lips. Tutorials label the look 'soft fall glam' or 'soft natural fall glam', often finished in a few minutes with cream products and lip gloss.
trends.title: Soft fall glam
